svg.title: rEach and Teach: the system at a glance
svg.desc: A student steers their own AI agent. rEach wraps the agent on the student's computer and talks over a signed wire to Teach, the private course server the instructors run.
svg.text: A student, their own AI agent, a bounded partner on their computer and a private course server that decides what counts.
the bounded course partner, inside the agent's harness
Does all the coding, in files, inside the student's slice.
course server · private to the instructors
who is in the course, on which computer
run on the server, never shipped
Author the rules, review the work, record the grade.
Plain words about the business; no
Every write, command and change is
